intro_body: [center]Welcome to Five Nights at Freddy's the original game TM. My name is Markipie and today we are traversing the Deep Deep Dungeonz as a Dawg, which is definitley some kind of american slang that means friend. Unfortunately this game is not about friends, though, and it's not about literal dawgs (dogs) either. It's about wolves (sorry) getting body horror-ed.
